title: Quiz: Mexico

description: Ten questions that check real understanding of Mexico. Answers included so you can self-test.
key_points: Q: What is the capital of Mexico? A: Mexico City
Q: What currency does Mexico use? A: Peso

demo.program:
# Mexico — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the capital of Mexico?", "Mexico City"),
    ("What currency does Mexico use?", "Peso"),
    ("What is capital?", "Mexico City"),
    ("What is currency?", "Peso (MXN)"),
    ("What is calling code?", "+52"),
    ("What is internet domain?", ".mx"),
    ("What is driving side?", "right"),
    ("What is continent?", "North America"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
